title.from: Agent tools for Papyrus sites: remote MCP and WebMCP
title.to: Hosted MCP server for staff and readers

description.from: Follow-up to agent-readable pages (PPY-f172d7): expose search/read (and later authorized actions) to external agents via a remote MCP server per site, and evaluate WebMCP for in-browser agents. Builds on the newsroom CLI/GraphQL surface. Not started.
description.to: Authenticated Streamable HTTP with site-bound rotating OAuth grants, typed staff tools and existing reader actions. Public discovery stays on HTTP. Verify with the seeded protocol harness before host trials.
